title: Singapore Couple Special | From Heritage Tales to Starlit Trails
highlights: Spend quality time together on a romantic getaway to Singapore that blends sightseeing, nature, light adventure, and immersive experiences in some the top attractions.
Ride the cable car to Sentosa while taking in sweeping views of the harbour, Mount Faber, and the island's vibrant coastline from above.
Enjoy a city tour of Singapore covering icons like the Merlion, Esplanade Theatre, Raffles Hotel, and the Singapore Flyer.
Step inside a Harry Potter experience at Sentosa, featuring glowing passageways, magical portals, and themed spaces inspired by the wizarding world.
Experience Changi Airport’s indoor gardens, sky-high nets, digital installations, and creative play zones at Canopy Park and the Changi Experience Studio.
overview:
About the Tour:
Experience the best of Singapore on a romantic getaway crafted for couples. Enjoy seamless airport transfers, comfortable stays at a well-rated city hotel, and a thoughtfully planned itinerary that blends city icons, nature escapes, scenic rides, and immersive exhibits. From exploring Chinatown and gliding over Sentosa to walking coastal trails and stepping into the magical world of Harry Potter at Resorts World Sentosa, every day offers something new. Wrap up your journey with interactive attractions at Changi, including garden mazes and sky nets. Perfectly paced and experience-rich, this trip is all about quality time, discovery, and shared memories.

know_before_you_go: Visitors must carry a passport with at least 6 months' validity from the date of entry. This serves as the primary and only accepted ID for immigration and hotel check-ins in Singapore.
The local currency is the Singapore Dollar (SGD). Currency exchange counters are widely available at the airport, malls, and tourist hubs.
Singapore has a tropical climate. Carry light cotton clothing, an umbrella for sudden rain, and stay hydrated while exploring.
Visitors can buy prepaid SIM cards or rent portable Wi-Fi devices at Changi Airport or convenience stores.
Singapore has strict laws on littering, jaywalking, vandalism, and chewing gum. Respect public rules to avoid fines.
Smoking is strictly prohibited in most public spaces, including malls, MRT stations, bus stops, parks, and inside taxis. Designated smoking areas are clearly marked.
Tourists with pre-booked tickets (e.g. Universal Studios, Gardens by the Bay) should arrive on time. Late arrivals may not be accommodated.
Respect safety barriers, restricted areas, and animal zones when visiting attractions like the zoo, aquariums, or nature parks.
Many attractions in Singapore open by 10:00 AM. Arriving early helps you avoid long queues, especially at Universal Studios, Mandai parks, and Sentosa rides.
At several attractions (e.g., Universal Studios, Mandai Parks, and museums), bag checks are mandatory. Large bags may be restricted or require locker storage.

In indoor attractions like museums, exhibits, and night parks, flash photography is restricted. Always observe signage and maintain a respectful volume, especially around animals or immersive installations.
Images are only for representation purposes. The actual experience may differ.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Singapore | Visit to Chinatown Heritage Centre | Night Safari
days.desc: Welcome to Singapore! Upon your arrival at the airport, get transferred to your hotel for check-in. Later, head out to explore the Chinatown Heritage Centre, where carefully restored interiors and life-sized exhibits reveal the untold stories of Singapore’s early settlers. In the evening, dive into the wilderness at Night Safari, where torch-lit trails, tram rides, and free-roaming nocturnal creatures offer an unforgettable after-dark encounter. Later, return to your hotel for the night.

days.title: Day Trip to Sentosa Island
days.desc: Get transferred to Sentosa for a scenic cable car roundtrip ride offering sweeping views over lush hills and sparkling sea. Experience breathtaking views on SkyHelix, a rotating open-air ride where you can also click amazing photos. Add playful excitement at HydroDash, Singapore’s only floating obstacle course. As dusk sets in, watch the Wings of Time light up the coast with water effects, lasers, and fireworks. Return to your hotel for a restful overnight stay.

days.title: Visit to ArtScience Museum | Enjoy Singapore City Tour with Singapore Flyer
days.desc: Begin the day exploring the Future World exhibit at the ArtScience Museum, where interactive digital installations respond to motion and light. Then set out on a city tour covering key landmarks like the Merlion Statue, Esplanade Theatre, and Raffles Hotel. Take in sweeping skyline views aboard the Singapore Flyer before ending your day with a romantic river cruise with your partner along Clarke Quay. Then return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Gaze from Marina Bay Sands SkyPark | Wander the Keppel Coastal Trail | Enter Harry Potter: Visions of Magic
days.desc: In the morning, get transferred to the Marina Bay Sands SkyPark, where you can admire the panoramic views of the city from above. Later, reconnect with nature along the Keppel Coastal Trail, a peaceful route filled with sea breeze and greenery. In the evening, explore Harry Potter: Visions of Magic, an immersive experience blending storytelling, light, and fantastical sets, making it a perfect end to your magical day. Later, head back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Explore Changi Experience Studio & Canopy Park Attractions | Departure
days.desc: Check out from your hotel and head to Changi Airport for a final adventure. Explore gamified exhibits and sensory zones at the Changi Experience Studio. Then head to Canopy Park’s creative spaces where you can enjoy everything from bouncing nets and misty bridges to mirror and hedge mazes. It’s a playful farewell to the city. After enjoying the attractions, board your departure flight with wonderful memories.
